breakdown.description: Normal shock waves only form in supersonic flow
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the physically impossible subsonic upstream Mach number (0.8). The ground truth correctly changed this to a supersonic Mach number of 2.0, as normal shock waves can only form in supersonic flow. The generated specification completely ignores the Mach number and does not fix this fundamental error.

breakdown.description: Second law of thermodynamics prohibits expansion shocks (subsonic to supersonic transitions via shock)
breakdown.reason: This inconsistency is a direct consequence of the first one. Because the agent did not correct the upstream Mach number to be supersonic, it failed to resolve the violation of the second law of thermodynamics. The ground truth resolves this by setting a supersonic upstream condition, which is the only scenario where a normal shock is physically possible.
